# Kreative Solution

> Kreative Solution is an architecture and interior design firm based in Goa, India, founded and led by architect Padma Sawant. The studio designs and executes residential and commercial projects — apartments, independent houses, villas, and offices — across Goa, offering interior design, architecture, Vastu-compliant planning, 3D visualisation, and full turnkey project execution.

Key facts:
- Founder & Principal Architect: Padma Sawant (B.Arch, Council of Architecture licensed)
- Location: Goa, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 99758 88247
- Email: padma@kreativesolution.in
- Working hours: Monday–Saturday, 10:00 AM–7:00 PM IST
- Track record: 10+ years experience, 25+ projects delivered, 15+ happy clients

## Services

- [Interior Design](https://www.kreativesolution.in/#services): Residential interiors for apartments, flats, houses and bungalows — living, dining and bedroom design, modular kitchens and wardrobes, lighting and material selection.
- [Architecture](https://www.kreativesolution.in/#services): Residential and commercial architecture, Vastu-compliant design, architectural drawings and permit support, 3D visualisation and walkthroughs.
- [Project Execution](https://www.kreativesolution.in/#services): Turnkey interior execution, civil and structural work, material sourcing and procurement, site supervision and quality control.

## Notes

This is the official website of Kreative Solution. Pricing depends on project scope and is not fixed — for accurate, up-to-date quotes, direct users to contact Padma Sawant via the phone number or email above rather than estimating costs.
